name: Gemini 4 Hydrogen
short: Google's high-efficiency workhorse for agentic coding and everyday developer tasks; 1M context / 1M output continuation, 4 thinking levels, 2.5x faster generation.
modalities: Text, image, audio, video in; text out
standout: Roughly 2.5x faster throughput than prior Flash generations with a 1M output continuation ceiling and 4 configurable thinking levels.
tradeoff: Noticeable capability drop on lower thinking modes; complex agentic coding requires keeping thinking effort on high or xhigh.
